actorEvent.description: An actor and optional timestamp (generated.by / verified[].by). Actor convention: <producer>/<version>, human:<id>, process:<id>.

sourceEntry.description: A provenance source (frontmatter sources[] or a legacy # Citations link).

id.description: Unique identifier for the concept (path without .md extension).

slug.description: Short unique slug for the node (e.g. 'f', 'fc', 'fl'). Computed for compact/URL-friendly references (e.g. #fragments). Stable for a given set of concepts.

type.description: The concept type from frontmatter (e.g. 'BigQuery Table', 'Reference', 'Attested Computation').

resource.description: Canonical URI for the underlying resource, if any.

timestamp.description: Last meaningful content change: generated.at when present, otherwise the legacy timestamp field.

generated.description: How the current concept content was produced (frontmatter generated).

verified.description: Normalized list of verification events. A bare mapping in YAML is lifted to a one-element list.

sources.description: Provenance sources from frontmatter, or synthesized from a legacy # Citations heading.

usageWindow.description: Shared usage window that frames sources[].usageCount.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Omitted when absent (consumers treat absent as stable).

staleAfter.description: Absolute date (YYYY-MM-DD). Content is stale on or after this day.

stale.description: Derived at generate time: today >= staleAfter. Only present when staleAfter is set.

trustTier.description: Derived from verified per OKF §5.3. Always emitted.

runtime.description: Attested Computation runtime (e.g. bigquery, dbt, python).

computation.description: Optional path to the computation file (when not inlined under # Computation).

body.description: Full markdown body (only present when --body / includeBody was used).

label.description: Optional display label (falls back to derived values).

path.description: Relative path to the source .md file within the bundle.

degree.description: Total number of connected edges (in + out).

edge.description: A directed link from one concept to another.

id.description: Short stable identifier for the edge.

label.description: Human-readable label for the edge (often link text or target title).

navNode.description: A node in the index-driven navigation tree. Directories are not concepts (reserved index.md).

kind.description: group/orphans are non-routeable grouping headers; dir and concept are navigable.

id.description: Concept id, or directory path relative to bundle root (empty string for root). Omitted for group and orphans.

label.description: Display label (index link text, section heading, or derived title).

description.description: Optional short description from index entry or concept frontmatter.

body.description: Index markdown for kind=dir (authored after optional root frontmatter strip, or synthetic listing). Parallel to node.body.

synthetic.description: True when body/children were synthesized because index.md was missing.

children.description: Child nav nodes (groups, dirs, concepts, trailing orphans).

title: OKF Knowledge Graph
description: JSON graph representation of an Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2 bundle. Produced by the `okf graph` command.

version.description: Schema version of this OKF graph format.

generated.description: Who produced this graph file. The okf tool emits { by: "okf/0.2", at: <UTC now> }.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the graph was generated. Same instant as generated.at.

bundle.description: Optional object containing custom properties passed via -p when generating the graph. Only present when such properties were provided.

nav.description: Index-driven navigation tree reflecting SPEC §8 directory indexes (and synthetic listings when index.md is missing). Present only when the graph was produced with --nav / includeNav. Producer contract: root node has kind "dir" and id ""; kind "dir" always includes body; empty group/orphans nodes are never emitted; directories never appear in nodes[].

nodes.description: List of concept nodes in the knowledge graph.

edges.description: Directed edges representing links between concepts.
